dist/subagent-*.whl -- provenance
=================================

Source worktree : <subagent-mcp checkout>
Branch          : omp-driver
Commit          : 7531144 (P2c: run on Windows; supersedes f73563c)
                  (git status --porcelain was empty when this hash was read;
                   the worktree was clean, so the hash pins the wheel content)

STATUS: the wheel itself is NOT present in this directory yet. It could not
be built in the packaging sandbox: every command that names the reference
worktree is denied there, including the one command the brief authorizes
(`uv build --wheel --out-dir <workspace>/dist` run in that directory).
Nothing in the package depends on a specific wheel hash, so the coordinator
can build it once, on any machine with uv, before running
`install.ps1 -WithSubagent`:

    cd <subagent-mcp checkout>
    uv build --wheel --out-dir <this repo>/dist
    git -C <subagent-mcp checkout> rev-parse HEAD
    # must print the commit hash above; if it does not, replace this file

What the build produces (pyproject.toml at that commit, hatchling backend,
version 0.1.0):

    subagent-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl

with the console scripts install.ps1 relies on:

    subagent     = subagent.cli:main          (doctor / init / run ...)
    subagent-mcp = subagent.mcp_server:main   (the MCP server VS Code runs)

install.ps1 -WithSubagent expects exactly one dist\subagent-*.whl next to
install.ps1, copies it to <InstallDir>\subagent\, and installs it with:

    uv tool install --python 3.12 --force <InstallDir>\subagent\<wheel file>
